item.title: Aso Adventure & Activity Park — Guide
item.description: Set amid the grasslands and mountains of the Aso region, this outdoor adventure and activity park offers active, family-friendly fun in one of Kumamoto’s most scenic landscapes. Depending on the season and facility, visitors can enjoy attractions such as ziplines and aerial ropeways, obstacle and adventure courses, cycling, water play and splash areas in summer, athletic playgrounds and other hands-on outdoor activities, all set against the sweeping backdrop of the Aso caldera.
